failure_summary.description: Search or filter results were produced without being saved to cache.
A newly supplied party size or neighborhood was treated as a no-op despite compatible cached results.
The hotel search was omitted even though its city and stay dates were known; clarification was requested for values already provided.
A fitness-center preference was mapped to the wrong hotel amenity field.
A state abbreviation was placed in the attraction city field rather than the state field.
An import from a nonexistent tools module caused execution to fail.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already directly covered by the skill’s cache, follow-up, domain-completion, location, and no-import rules, and prior attempts to elaborate those rules were ineffective. Add only the observed hotel amenity synonym mapping that is not explicit in the current schema guidance.

edits.target: Map ordinary-language descriptions to a supported schema criterion when the meaning is unambiguous (for example, map “laundry facilities” to `has_laundry_service` when that field is in the tool schema); if no field represents a preference, omit it rather than adding an unsupported argument.
edits.content: Map ordinary-language descriptions to a supported schema criterion when the meaning is unambiguous (for example, map “laundry facilities” to `has_laundry_service` when that field is in the tool schema, and a hotel “fitness center” request to `has_fitness_class` when supported); if no field represents a preference, omit it rather than adding an unsupported argument.
